items.title: Self-Infect
items.placementTarget: Rulebook page 12, slot Q (New Actions, right column, bottom)
items.text:
SELF-INFECT
While in the PEARL lab, scratch off exposures until you reveal a [red double-mark] or [red skull]. If you reveal a [red double-mark], add the Carrier scar to your Character card. You are now carrying 1000x the safe dose of the sample in your body.
WARNING: this scar has dangerous side effects. Be sure to read it.
The Carrier scar covers two slots on your Character card. Do not cover another scar, if possible.

rules: You must be in the PEARL lab.
Scratch exposure boxes one at a time until the result is the red double-mark or the red skull.
The red double-mark adds the Carrier scar. You are carrying 1000x the safe dose.
The sticker tells you to read the Carrier scar. It does not print the skull's effect.
The Carrier scar occupies two character-card slots.
Prefer not to cover an existing scar.
mechanics.effect: Forced exposure scratching that either makes you the Carrier or stops on a skull.

summary: Action in the PEARL lab: scratch exposures until a red double-mark or a red skull. The double-mark adds the Carrier scar (two slots) and means you carry 1000x the safe dose. The sticker does not restate the skull's effect.
